metadata.title: Shades and Convexity of Hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: Let $f\colon M^n\to\mathbf{R}^{n+1}$, $n\geq2$, be a smooth immersion of a closed oriented manifold, with Gauss map $\nu\colon M\to\mathbf{S}^n$. For each unit vector $u$, the shade $S_u\subset M$ is the set of points where $\nu$ makes an acute angle with $u$. We show that $f$ is a convex embedding if and only if every shade is contractible. More generally, if every shade is $k$-connected, then $f$ is a convex embedding provided that $n\leq 2k+1$, or $n=2k+2$ and $H_{k+1}(M;\mathbf{Z})=0$. On the other hand, for every $n\geq 2k+3$ there is a nonconvex embedding $f\colon\mathbf{S}^n\to\mathbf{R}^{n+1}$ all of whose shades are $k$-connected. These results give sharp answers to a question of H. Wente in all dimensions.

analysis.progressType: 由Gauss映射shade拓扑刻画超曲面凸性
analysis.workSummary: 对n≥2的闭定向流形在R^(n+1)中的光滑浸入，shade为法向与给定u成锐角的点集。作者证明每个shade可缩当且仅当为凸嵌入。更一般，全部shade k连通时，n≤2k+1或n=2k+2且H_(k+1)(M;Z)=0可推出凸性。n≥2k+3则有非凸嵌入球面仍满足该连通性。
analysis.breakthrough: 以shade的拓扑信息给凸性的维数门槛，并在高维构造锐利反例。
analysis.limitations: k连通条件的边界维数另需整同调消失，不能删去该附加条件；可缩判据要求所有方向的shade。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
